_comment: Stage 2 缺中文对照词的静态兜底例句（82 词）。全部人工手写：英文含本词、4–20 词、无专名；中文纯汉字且忠实翻译。22-choose-examples.mjs 优先于 Tatoeba。

circumspect.exampleEn: Be circumspect when you sign any contract.
circumspect.exampleCn: 签任何合同都要谨慎小心。

inspection.exampleEn: The machine passed its final safety inspection.
inspection.exampleCn: 这台机器通过了最后的安全检查。

circumspection.exampleEn: He handled the delicate matter with great circumspection.
circumspection.exampleCn: 他非常审慎地处理了这件棘手的事。

predictable.exampleEn: The ending of the film was completely predictable.
predictable.exampleCn: 这部电影的结局完全在预料之中。

predictive.exampleEn: High test scores are predictive of college success.
predictive.exampleCn: 考试高分可以预示大学阶段的成功。

porter.exampleEn: The porter carried our luggage to the room.
porter.exampleCn: 行李员把我们的行李搬到了房间。

cordial.exampleEn: They received a cordial welcome from the hosts.
cordial.exampleCn: 他们受到了主人们热忱的欢迎。

province.exampleEn: That region became a province only recently.
province.exampleCn: 那个地区不久前才设省。

convict.exampleEn: The jury took only an hour to convict the thief.
convict.exampleCn: 陪审团只用一个小时就判定那名窃贼有罪。

compose.exampleEn: She paused for a moment to compose herself.
compose.exampleCn: 她停顿片刻，让自己镇定下来。

postpone.exampleEn: We decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
postpone.exampleCn: 我们决定把会议推迟到下星期。

exponent.exampleEn: She is a leading exponent of modern dance.
exponent.exampleCn: 她是现代舞的主要倡导者。

primate.exampleEn: The zoo keeps several rare primate species.
primate.exampleCn: 动物园饲养着几种珍稀的灵长类动物。

primal.exampleEn: Fear of the dark is a primal emotion.
primal.exampleCn: 怕黑是一种原始的情绪。

vaccinate.exampleEn: Doctors vaccinate children against measles every spring.
vaccinate.exampleCn: 医生们每年春天给儿童接种麻疹疫苗。

compel.exampleEn: Nothing can compel me to change my mind.
compel.exampleCn: 什么也不能强迫我改变主意。

repel.exampleEn: This spray can repel mosquitoes for hours.
repel.exampleCn: 这种喷雾能驱蚊好几个小时。

propel.exampleEn: The strong wind helped propel the boat forward.
propel.exampleCn: 强风帮助推动小船前进。

expel.exampleEn: The school may expel students who cheat repeatedly.
expel.exampleCn: 学校可能开除屡次作弊的学生。

flexible.exampleEn: Our working hours are quite flexible.
flexible.exampleCn: 我们的工作时间相当灵活。

deflect.exampleEn: He told a joke to deflect the question.
deflect.exampleCn: 他讲了个笑话来转移这个问题。

deflection.exampleEn: The deflection of the ball surprised the goalkeeper.
deflection.exampleCn: 球的偏转让守门员大吃一惊。

inflexible.exampleEn: The old manager was inflexible about the rules.
inflexible.exampleCn: 老经理对这些规矩非常固执。

transformer.exampleEn: A transformer changes the voltage of electric power.
transformer.exampleCn: 变压器能改变电力的电压。

fortress.exampleEn: The soldiers defended the fortress for thirty days.
fortress.exampleCn: 士兵们坚守那座要塞三十天。

fortify.exampleEn: They fortify the walls before every winter.
fortify.exampleCn: 每年入冬前他们都加固城墙。

infusion.exampleEn: This tea is an infusion of dried flowers.
infusion.exampleCn: 这种茶是用干花泡制的。

diffuse.exampleEn: The room was lit by diffuse morning light.
diffuse.exampleCn: 房间里弥漫着柔和的晨光。

inadequate.exampleEn: The emergency supplies were inadequate for so many people.
inadequate.exampleCn: 应急物资对这么多的人来说远远不够。

hydrant.exampleEn: Park your car away from the fire hydrant.
hydrant.exampleCn: 请把车停在离消防栓远一点的地方。

dehydrate.exampleEn: Drink water often so you do not dehydrate.

dehydration.exampleEn: Long hikes in the heat can cause dehydration.
dehydration.exampleCn: 炎热天气下长途跋涉可能导致脱水。

hydraulic.exampleEn: The excavator uses a hydraulic system to lift heavy loads.
hydraulic.exampleCn: 挖掘机用液压系统吊起重物。

inhibit.exampleEn: Fear should not inhibit your creativity.
inhibit.exampleCn: 恐惧不应该抑制你的创造力。

inhabit.exampleEn: Millions of people inhabit this river delta.
inhabit.exampleCn: 数百万人居住在这个河口三角洲。

habitual.exampleEn: His habitual smile put everyone at ease.
habitual.exampleCn: 他习惯性的微笑让每个人都放松下来。

collaborate.exampleEn: The two labs collaborate on cancer research.
collaborate.exampleCn: 这两个实验室在癌症研究方面合作。

collaboration.exampleEn: The design was a collaboration between old friends.
collaboration.exampleCn: 这项设计是老朋友们合作的成果。

laborious.exampleEn: Copying every page by hand was laborious work.
laborious.exampleCn: 用手抄写每一页是件费力的活。

congratulation.exampleEn: Please accept my congratulation on your promotion.
congratulation.exampleCn: 请接受我对你升职的祝贺。

gratify.exampleEn: It would gratify her to see the garden bloom.
gratify.exampleCn: 看到花园开满花会让她心满意足。

saint.exampleEn: My grandmother was a saint to the whole village.
saint.exampleCn: 我的祖母对全村人来说都是圣人。

consecrate.exampleEn: The bishop will consecrate the new church.
consecrate.exampleCn: 主教将祝圣这座新教堂。

testament.exampleEn: Her long recovery is a testament to her willpower.
testament.exampleCn: 她漫长的康复证明了她意志的力量。

contestant.exampleEn: Each contestant has ninety seconds on stage.
contestant.exampleCn: 每位选手在台上有一分半钟。

literacy.exampleEn: The program teaches basic literacy to adults.
literacy.exampleCn: 这项计划教成年人基本的读写能力。

obliterate.exampleEn: The bombing obliterated the entire village.
obliterate.exampleCn: 轰炸把整座村庄夷为平地。

lever.exampleEn: Pull the lever to start the machine.
lever.exampleCn: 拉动操纵杆来启动机器。

immigrant.exampleEn: Her grandfather was an immigrant from a small village.
immigrant.exampleCn: 她的祖父是来自一个小村庄的移民。

migrant.exampleEn: The refuge shelters migrant birds in winter.
migrant.exampleCn: 这个保护区在冬天收留候鸟。

migratory.exampleEn: Migratory birds fly south before the cold arrives.
migratory.exampleCn: 候鸟在寒冷到来之前飞往南方。

miraculous.exampleEn: The medicine produced a miraculous recovery.
miraculous.exampleCn: 这种药带来了奇迹般的康复。

fluctuate.exampleEn: Vegetable prices fluctuate with the seasons.

influx.exampleEn: The city saw a huge influx of tourists.
influx.exampleCn: 这座城市涌入了大量游客。

tangible.exampleEn: The team finally made tangible progress.
tangible.exampleCn: 团队终于取得了实实在在的进展。

tactile.exampleEn: Babies learn about the world through tactile exploration.
tactile.exampleCn: 婴儿通过触觉探索来认识世界。

contagious.exampleEn: Laughter is contagious in a crowded theater.
contagious.exampleCn: 在拥挤的剧场里，笑声是会传染的。

innovation.exampleEn: Every product begins with a small innovation.
innovation.exampleCn: 每件产品都始于一个小小的创新。

renovate.exampleEn: They plan to renovate the old library.
renovate.exampleCn: 他们计划翻新那座旧图书馆。

novice.exampleEn: As a novice, she practices the piano daily.
novice.exampleCn: 作为新手，她每天练习钢琴。

saucer.exampleEn: The cat licked milk from the saucer.

saline.exampleEn: The nurse cleaned the wound with saline solution.
saline.exampleCn: 护士用盐水清洗了伤口。

artifact.exampleEn: The museum displays every artifact from the ancient tomb.
artifact.exampleCn: 博物馆展出古墓中出土的每一件器物。

physicist.exampleEn: The physicist explained the experiment in simple words.
physicist.exampleCn: 这位物理学家用简单的话解释了这个实验。

physiology.exampleEn: Anatomy and physiology are basic courses for nurses.
physiology.exampleCn: 解剖学和生理学是护士的基础课程。

transmit.exampleEn: Mosquitoes can transmit malaria to humans.
transmit.exampleCn: 蚊子能把疟疾传染给人类。

intermittent.exampleEn: Intermittent rain lasted the whole afternoon.
intermittent.exampleCn: 断断续续的雨下了一整个下午。

medieval.exampleEn: The castle was built in medieval times.

mediocre.exampleEn: The restaurant was expensive but mediocre.
mediocre.exampleCn: 那家餐馆价格贵但很平庸。

centimetre.exampleEn: The ruler shows each centimetre clearly.
centimetre.exampleCn: 尺子上的每一厘米都清晰可见。

kilometre.exampleEn: The nearest village is one kilometre away.
kilometre.exampleCn: 最近的村庄在一公里之外。

symmetry.exampleEn: The building is admired for its perfect symmetry.
symmetry.exampleCn: 这座建筑因完美的对称而受人赞叹。

perimeter.exampleEn: Guards patrol the perimeter of the camp.

judicious.exampleEn: A judicious choice saves both time and money.
judicious.exampleCn: 明智的选择既省时间又省钱。

metropolitan.exampleEn: Millions of commuters travel within the metropolitan area.
metropolitan.exampleCn: 数百万人在都会区内通勤。

cosmopolitan.exampleEn: The city has a cosmopolitan feel.
cosmopolitan.exampleCn: 这座城市有世界主义的风情。

circumscribe.exampleEn: Strict laws circumscribe the power of officials.
circumscribe.exampleCn: 严格的法律限制官员的权力。

convention.exampleEn: Wearing black to a funeral is a convention.
convention.exampleCn: 葬礼上穿黑衣是一种习俗。

circumvent.exampleEn: They found a way to circumvent the traffic.
circumvent.exampleCn: 他们找到了一条避开车流的路线。

optimism.exampleEn: Her optimism kept the whole team going.
optimism.exampleCn: 她的乐观让整个团队坚持了下去。

optical.exampleEn: The magician used an optical illusion.
optical.exampleCn: 魔术师利用了一种视错觉。
